customers_say: Customers find the water purifier reliable and appreciate its appearance, with one noting it's suitable for a family of 4 to 5 people. Moreover, the water quality is excellent after purification, and customers like the taste. However, the installation process is quick, and while the brand offers good service support, some report extremely bad customer care. Additionally, durability is a concern, with multiple customers reporting that the RO membrane fails within 6 months of use.

reviews.author: smita
reviews.title: Product is good but installation was disappointing
reviews.body: The water purifier itself is excellent and has been working perfectly. However, the installation experience was very disappointing. The installation engineer strongly pushed me to purchase a TDS controller and a water pressure control device, even after I clearly informed him that my home receives PMC water. I felt pressured into buying these additional accessories. After testing, my water’s TDS level was found to be just 7, clearly indicating that the TDS controller was unnecessary. It seems these recommendations were driven more by upselling than by the actual water quality and customer need

reviews.author: Sonu Kumar
reviews.title: Good RO, But Needs Some Improvements
reviews.body: Product quality और water purification अच्छा है। Installation भी समय पर हो गया था। Water taste भी अच्छा है। लेकिन कुछ बातें बेहतर हो सकती थीं: Company ने 5 L storage बताया है, जबकि usable water लगभग 4–4.5 L ही मिलता है। Tap (water outlet) का flow थोड़ा slow है क्योंकि outlet hole छोटा है। TDS Adjuster/Controller product के साथ included नहीं मिलता। अगर यह दिया जाता तो users अपनी जरूरत के अनुसार TDS आसानी से adjust कर सकते। Technician/engineer high price में TDS controller sell करते हैं। Overall product अच्छा है, लेकिन इन improvements के साथ और बेहतर हो सकता है !

reviews.author: kiran kumar
reviews.title: Good product but bad customer service.
reviews.body: The product is good. The customer service isn’t so great though. He wouldn’t show up when he promised that he would. So, please be prepared. He wouldn’t show try to upsell you stuff saying I would need a valve for water pressure or that the TDS is higher than expected etc. when you buy the add on he offers, he wouldn’t give any receipt. Other than the customer experience, the product is good. I tested the TDS before and after installation and the water purifier is working as desired.
